_about: Video transitions catalog with parameters. Shader code is not included.

transitions.name: Anticipation Zoom
transitions.description: Outgoing clip winds back then punches forward with a directional stretch blur as the incoming clip eases in from a zoomed-out scale.

transitions.name: Clean Line Wipe
transitions.description: A clean directional wipe with a thin sweeping line dividing the outgoing and incoming clips.

transitions.name: Cross Dissolve
transitions.description: Smoothly blends the outgoing clip into the incoming clip with an adjustable easing curve.

transitions.name: Dip to Black
transitions.description: Fades the outgoing clip to black, holds, then fades up the incoming clip.

transitions.name: Flash
transitions.description: Flashes to a solid color at the midpoint with an overexposure bloom, switching from the outgoing to incoming clip behind the flash.

transitions.name: blend
transitions.description: Perform a blend operation between two sources

transitions.name: Impact Shake
transitions.description: Punches in with a shake, RGB split and flash at the cut point, simulating a physical impact or beat hit.

transitions.name: Luma Blend
transitions.description: Luminance-based blend that crossfades clips while boosting bright areas, morphing between screen and additive blending.

transitions.name: Organic Light Dissolve
transitions.description: Dissolves the outgoing clip through an organic fbm-noise blob edge with a glowing burn-up rim revealing the incoming clip.

transitions.name: Page Curl
transitions.description: The outgoing clip peels and curls away like a turning page, revealing the incoming clip with paper grain, shadows and a glossy specular edge.

transitions.name: Rack Focus
transitions.description: Defocuses the outgoing clip into a soft bokeh blur, then refocuses to reveal the incoming clip with chromatic aberration and veiling glare.

transitions.name: Soft Wipe
transitions.description: Outgoing clip wipes off horizontally with a feathered, soft edge and a subtle parallax shift as the incoming clip slides in.

transitions.name: Whip Pan
transitions.description: Simulates a fast camera whip pan: clip A smears out to one side with motion blur while clip B whips in from the other and settles with an elastic overshoot.
